name: already-told-you
description: Stop typing 'I already told you this' to Claude. Reads your Claude Code history and tells you where it keeps going wrong, what you keep re-explaining, which skills you should already have (and drafts them), and which jobs you repeat by hand (and how to automate them). Free. No account, no third-party service, no network calls of its own: a local extractor plus your own Claude Code session.
